args.query: information security policy objectives approval requirements review
policy publication intranet change notices review

gather.answer: The information security policy 4.0 was approved by management on 14 July 2026. It states why security matters to the business, sets its objectives, and derives the security requirements each year from the business plan, customer contracts and German law. It is published on the intranet with nine supporting standards and procedures, and change notices go to employees and, through the supplier portal, to suppliers. No document says what happens when someone breaks the policy, and the encryption standard it names has not been reviewed since March 2022.
